item.title: U.S. State Department Officials Meet Families of Abductees, Expressing Attention to Their Plight (美국무부 인사들, 납북자 가족 만나 “관심 기울이고 있다”)
item.description:
U.S. State Department Officials Meet Families of Abductees, Expressing Attention to Their Plight (美국무부 인사들, 납북자 가족 만나 “관심 기울이고 있다”)

U.S. State Department officials visiting South Korea have met with families of those abducted, detained, or held as prisoners of war by North Korea, stating that they are paying attention to enabling separated families to reunite. (방한한 미 국무부 인사들이 납북자, 억류자, 국군 포로 가족들을 면담하고 “북한에 의해 헤어진 가족들이 만날 수 있도록 관심을 기울이고 있다”고 했다.)

According to the Association of Families of Abductees during the Korean War (the Association) announced on the 15th, Julie Turner, Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary of the U.S. State Department's Bureau of Democracy, Human Rights, and Labor, along with other State Department officials, met with representatives of the Association at the U.S. Embassy in South Korea on the 10th. (줄리 터너 미 국무부 민주주의·인권·노동국 부차관보 대행 등 국무부 관계자들은 지난 10일 주한 미국 대사관에서 6·25전쟁납북인사가족협의회(가족회) 관계자 등을 면담했다고 15일 가족회가 밝혔다.)

During the meeting, the Association stated, "Even after 76 years, not a single family member abducted during the Korean War has returned, nor have we even been able to confirm their fate," adding, "No South Korean government has actively raised this issue with North Korea or sought to resolve it." (가족회는 면담에서 “76년이 지나도록 6·25전쟁 중 납북되신 가족 단 한 분도 돌아오시기는커녕 생사조차 확인하지 못하고 있다”며 “대한민국 어떤 정부도 이 문제를 적극적으로 북한에 제기하고 해결하려 하지 않았다”고 했다.)

The Association delivered an open letter to U.S. President Donald Trump, requesting that he directly demand from North Korea the repatriation of South Korean nationals currently detained by North Korea, confirmation of the fate of abductees, and permission for family visits to ancestral graves in North Korea. (가족회는 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 현재 북한에 억류 중인 대한민국 국민의 송환, 납북자의 생사 확인, 성묘단 방북 등을 북한에 직접 요구해 달라는 내용의 공개 서한을 전달했다.)

The groups reported that Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary Turner expressed during the meeting that the U.S. is attentive to facilitating reunions for families separated by North Korea, not only among Korean-Americans in the United States but globally. (터너 대행은 이 자리에서 미국 내 한인뿐 아니라, 전 세계에서 북한에 의해 헤어진 가족들이 만날 수 있도록 하는 일에 관심을 기울이고 있다는 뜻을 밝혔다고 단체들은 전했다.)

Attending the meeting were Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary Turner, Lindsay Fosmanick, a U.S. State Department foreign affairs officer, and U.S. Embassy officials. Participants included Lee Seong-ui, Chairman of the Association of Families of Abductees during the Korean War; Choi Seong-ryong, Chairman of the Post-Korean War Abductee Victims' Family Association; and Son Myeong-hwa, Representative of the Korean War POWs' Family Association. (이날 면담에는 터너 대행을 비롯해 린지 포스매닉 국무부 외교담당관, 미 대사관 관계자들이 참석했다. 6·25전쟁납북인사가족협의회 이성의 이사장, 전후납북피해가족연합회 최성룡 이사장, 6·25국군포로가족회 손명화 대표 등이 참석했다.)

On the 9th, Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary Turner and her team also met with families of South Korean missionaries who have been detained in North Korea for over a decade. (터너 대행 등은 지난 9일에는 북한에 10년 이상 장기 억류 중인 우리 선교사 가족을 면담했다.)

item.title: Yoo Si-min: “I Will Leave the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation… Requesting Dismissal as Standing Advisor” (유시민 “노무현재단 떠나겠다… 상임고문 해촉요청”)
item.description:
Yoo Si-min: “I Will Leave the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation… Requesting Dismissal as Standing Advisor” (유시민 “노무현재단 떠나겠다… 상임고문 해촉요청”)

Yoo Si-min, former chairman of the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation, stated on the 15th, “I will stay away from the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation for the time being.” (유시민 전 노무현재단 이사장이 “당분간 노무현재단을 떠나서 살겠다”고 15일 말했다.)

Although former Chairman Yoo completed his term as chairperson of the foundation in 2021, he has been uploading videos to the foundation’s YouTube channel, such as his own book launch events and discussion clips unrelated to former President Roh. (유 전 이사장은 2021년 재단 이사장직 임기를 마쳤지만, 재단 유튜브 채널 등에 자신의 출판기념회나 노 전 대통령과 관계 없는 대담 영상을 올려 왔다.)

Former Chairman Yoo said on the foundation’s website that day, “I have requested the foundation to dismiss me as standing advisor. I have also notified them that ‘Allileo Books’ will be discontinued at the end of June.” (유 전 이사장은 이날 재단 홈페이지를 통해 “재단에 상임고문 해촉을 요청했다. 알릴레오북스도 6월 말에 중단한다고 통보했다”고 했다.)

He explained the reason, stating, “This is to prevent any difficulties the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation might face due to the critical activities I will engage in from now on.” He added, “Please take good care of the foundation until the day we meet again.” <<> Kwak Sang-eon, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea and former President Roh Moo-hyun’s son-in-law, has previously criticized the foundation for operating centered around former Chairman Yoo’s promotions. <<> Lawmaker Kwak noted, “Among the more than 2,000 videos uploaded to the foundation’s YouTube channel, only about 360 videos are related to former President Roh, comprising 220 general videos and 140 shorts.” He added that content featuring former Chairman Yoo accounts for nearly 70% of the total. (그러면서 “앞으로 제가 할 비평 활동 때문에 노무현 재단이 혹시 겪게 될지도 모를 어려움을 예방하기 위해서”라고 이유를 밝혔다. 그는 “다시 만나는 날까지 재단을 잘 지켜달라”라고도 덧붙였다.)

item.title: Reform Party Files Election Appeals for Selective Re-elections in 18 Districts, Including Seoul, Busan, and Gyeonggi (개혁신당, 서울·부산·경기 등 18곳 ‘선별적 재선거’ 선거소청 제기)
item.description:
Reform Party Files Election Appeals for Selective Re-elections in 18 Districts, Including Seoul, Busan, and Gyeonggi (개혁신당, 서울·부산·경기 등 18곳 ‘선별적 재선거’ 선거소청 제기)

The Reform Party filed election appeals with the National Election Commission on the 15th, arguing for 'selective re-elections' in response to the shortage of ballot papers during the June 3 local elections. (개혁신당이 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 ‘선별적 재선거를 실시해야 한다’면서 15일 중앙선거관리위원회에 선거소청(選擧訴請)을 제기했다.)

The appeals filed by the Reform Party target a total of 18 cases, including the elections for Seoul Mayor, Busan Mayor, Daegu Mayor, Incheon Mayor, and Gyeonggi Governor, as well as proportional representation elections for Seoul City Council, Busan City Council, Daegu City Council, and Gyeonggi Provincial Council. The Reform Party explained that these appeals pertain to 18 polling stations where the party had candidates, out of the 26 locations where voting was temporarily halted on election day due to a ballot paper shortage. (개혁신당이 제기한 선거소청 대상은 서울시장·부산시장·대구시장·인천시장·경기지사 선거, 서울시의원·부산시의원·대구시의원·경기도의원 비례대표 선거 등 총 18건이다. 선거 당일 투표용지가 부족해 한때 투표가 중단됐던 26곳의 투표소 가운데 개혁신당이 후보를 낸 18곳에 대해 선거소청에 나서는 것이라고 개혁신당 측은 설명했다.)

Reform Party floor leader Cheon Ha-ram and former Seoul mayoral candidate Kim Jeong-cheol submitted the 'petition for selective re-elections due to ballot paper shortage' at the Gwacheon Election Commission office in Gyeonggi Province on the afternoon of the same day. Floor leader Cheon told reporters, "To swiftly restore voting rights, it is essential to hold re-elections, even selectively, at the polling stations where the problem occurred." (개혁신당 천하람 원내대표와 김정철 전 서울시장 후보는 이날 오후 경기 과천 선관위 청사를 찾아 ‘투표용지 부족 사태에 따른 선별적 재선거 소청장’을 제출했다. 천 원내대표는 기자들과 만나 “참정권을 빠르게 회복시키기 위해서는 문제가 발생했던 투표소에 대해서 선별적으로나마 재선거를 실시하는 것이 반드시 필요하다”고 말했다.)

An election appeal is when voters, candidates, or political parties contest the validity of an election with the relevant election commission within 14 days of the election day. Under the Public Official Election Act, presidential and National Assembly elections can directly proceed to an election lawsuit in court to challenge the election's validity, but local elections require first filing an election appeal with the Election Commission. The deadline for filing election appeals for the June 3 local elections is within 14 days, by June 17. (선거소청은 유권자나 후보자, 정당 등이 선거일로부터 14일 안에 관할 선거관리위원회를 상대로 선거 효력에 이의를 주장하는 것이다. 공직선거법상 대통령·국회의원 선거는 바로 법원에 선거 효력을 묻는 선거소송(選擧訴訟)을 할 수 있지만, 지방선거는 우선 선관위에 선거소청을 제기해야 한다. 6·3 지방선거의 선거소청 제기 기한은 14일 이내인 오는 17일까지다.)

Floor leader Cheon urged the People Power Party and the Democratic Party to join the election appeals. He said, "People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, don't just talk about 'holding full re-elections'; file election appeals for the elections where the People Power Party had candidates before June 17." He added, "I strongly request that the Democratic Party also file election appeals and that the two major parties contribute to restoring the voting rights of the people." (천 원내대표는 국민의힘과 더불어민주당을 향해 선거소청 동참을 촉구했다. 그는 “국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 말로만 ‘전면적 재선거를 하자’고 하지 말고 6월 17일이 되기 전에 국민의힘이 후보를 냈던 선거에 선거소청을 내라”면서 “민주당도 선거소청을 내서 국민들의 참정권이 회복되는 데 거대 양당이 힘을 보태주길 강하게 요청한다”고 말했다.)

With the Reform Party filing the election appeals, the Election Commission must make a decision within 60 days of receiving the appeals. If the Commission accepts the appeals, re-elections will be held within 30 days from the date of the decision notice. However, the National Election Commission stated on the 4th that the ballot paper shortage "does not constitute grounds for postponing an election or holding a re-election under the Public Official Election Act." (개혁신당이 선거소청을 제기함에 따라 선관위는 선거소청을 접수한 날로부터 60일 내 결정을 내려야 한다. 선관위가 소청을 받아들이면 결정 통지일로부터 30일 이내 재선거가 실시된다. 다만, 중앙선관위는 지난 4일 이미 투표용지 부족 사태가 “공직선거법에 따른 선거의 연기나 재선거 사유에 해당하지 않는다”고 밝혔다.)

Conversely, if the Election Commission decides to dismiss or reject the appeals, the appellant can file an election lawsuit in court within 10 days. The court must issue a ruling within 180 days from the date the lawsuit is filed. Article 224 of the Public Official Election Act stipulates, "Even if a violation of election regulations exists, a decision or ruling to invalidate all or part of an election or the election of a candidate shall be made only when it is deemed to have affected the election results." (반면에 선관위가 기각 또는 각하 결정을 내린다면 선거소청 제기자는 10일 이내 법원에 선거소송을 제기할 수 있다. 법원은 소송 제기일로부터 180일 안에 판결을 내려야 한다. 공직선거법 제224조는 “선거에 관한 규정에 위반된 사실이 있는 때라도 선거의 결과에 영향을 미쳤다고 인정하는 때에 한하여 선거의 전부나 일부의 무효 또는 당선의 무효를 결정하거나 판결한다”고 규정하고 있다.)

item.title: PPP Floor Leader Jung Jeom-sik Visits Lee Jun-seok, Calling Him "A Precious Partner to Work With" (국힘 정점식, 이준석 예방 “함께할 소중한 분”)
item.description:
PPP Floor Leader Jung Jeom-sik Visits Lee Jun-seok, Calling Him "A Precious Partner to Work With" (국힘 정점식, 이준석 예방 “함께할 소중한 분”)

People Power Party Floor Leader Jung Jeom-sik on the 15th referred to Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok as "a precious asset of conservatism" and "a valuable person who will stand together in defending the values of liberal democracy and market order." Jung, who was elected as the new floor leader on the 10th, visited the Reform Party leadership on this day as a courtesy call following his inauguration. Lee Jun-seok served as the People Power Party's party leader from 2021 to 2022 before leaving the party to establish the Reform Party. (국민의힘 정점식 원내대표는 15일 개혁신당 이준석 대표를 “보수의 소중한 자산” “자유민주주의와 시장 질서라는 가치 수호에 함께할 소중한 분”이라고 표현했다. 지난 10일 신임 원내대표에 당선된 정 원내대표는 이날 취임 인사차 개혁신당 지도부를 예방했다. 이준석 대표는 2021~2022년 국민의힘 당대표를 지냈다가 탈당해 개혁신당을 창당했다.)

Floor Leader Jung visited the Reform Party's leader office at the National Assembly that morning to meet with Lee Jun-seok and Reform Party Floor Leader Cheon Ha-ram. During the meeting, Jung stated, "There are many immediate tasks we need to fight together, such as the nullified indictment (dismissal of prosecution) special counsel and the shortage of ballot papers in the recent local elections," and added, "I ask that you always stand with us in blocking the rampage of the Lee Jae-myung regime." (정점식 원내대표는 이날 오전 국회 개혁신당 당대표실을 찾아 이준석 대표와 개혁신당 천하람 원내대표를 만났다. 이 자리에서 정 원내대표는 “재판 취소(공소 취소) 특검과 이번 지방선거에서의 투표용지 부족 사태 등 많은 것들이 함께 투쟁해야 할 당면 과제”라면서 “이재명 정권의 폭주를 막아서는 데 늘 함께해주실 것을 당부드린다”고 말했다.)

In response, Lee Jun-seok said, "There will be many issues where we need to cooperate regarding the Lee Jae-myung government's policy excesses, such as the nullified indictment special counsel," and emphasized, "Above all, it is important to prevent the recurrence of the Democratic Party-led unilateralism in the National Assembly's operations." Reform Party Floor Leader Cheon Ha-ram added, "Regarding the nullified indictment special counsel, since many citizens issued a warning in this local election, I hope the Lee Jae-myung government does not act rashly. If such a situation arises, we must join forces to stop it by any means necessary." (이에 이준석 대표는 “이재명 정부가 공소취소 특검 등 여러 정책적 폭주하는 데 있어서 협력할 사안이 많을 것”이라며 “무엇보다 국회 운영 과정에서 더불어민주당 중심의 일방주의가 반복되지 않도록 하는 게 중요하다”고 했다. 천하람 원내대표는 “공소 취소 특검 부분은 이번 지방선거에서 많은 국민들이 경고를 보내셨기 때문에 이재명 정부가 경거망동하지 않기를 바란다”며 “만약 그런 경우가 있다면 무슨 수를 써서라도 막아내는 데 힘을 합쳐야겠다”고 했다.)

The meeting between the leadership of the two parties proceeded in a friendly atmosphere. Floor Leader Jung and Leader Lee initially deferred to each other over who would speak first, eventually settling on Lee giving the opening remarks. After the meeting, People Power Party Senior Deputy Floor Leader Choi Soo-jin told reporters, "(In the closed-door discussion,) we talked about the hope that the Reform Party would actively participate in matters such as the special counsel for the National Election Commission, which involves non-negotiating groups, or parliamentary investigations." When asked if he would pursue regular meetings with the People Power Party leadership going forward, Lee responded, "When new people emerge, there can be changes in the approach that follows." (이날 양당 지도부 회동은 화기애애한 분위기에서 진행됐다. 정 원내대표와 이 대표는 첫 발언권을 두고 서로에게 양보하다가 결국 이 대표가 먼저 발언하는 것으로 정리했다. 국민의힘 최수진 원내수석대변인은 양당 지도부 회동 후 기자들과 만나 “(비공개 회담에서) 비교섭단체가 들어가는 선거관리위원회 특검이나 국정조사 등에 개혁신당도 적극 참여했으면 좋겠다는 이야기를 나눴다”고 했다. 이 대표도 향후 국민의힘 지도부와 정기적 모임을 추진할 것이냐는 질문에 “새로운 사람이 등장하면 그에 따른 방식의 변화가 있을 수 있다”고 답했다.)

item.title: Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik: "Review Unpassed Bills and Delayed National Agenda" (강훈식 “미통과 법안·지연된 국정과제 점검하라”)
item.description:
Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik: "Review Unpassed Bills and Delayed National Agenda" (강훈식 “미통과 법안·지연된 국정과제 점검하라”)

Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik on the 15th, marking the second year of the government's launch, ordered a review of bills that failed to pass the National Assembly and national tasks that are being delayed. <<> Chief Kang held a meeting of senior secretaries chaired by the Chief of Staff at the presidential office that afternoon to review the progress of national tasks. Regarding the first year since President Lee Jae-myung's government took office, Chief Kang assessed, "It was a time of recovery, leap forward, and building an irreplaceable Republic of Korea." He cited achievements including the KOSPI surpassing 8,000 for the first time, record-breaking exports of $700 billion, and K-defense industry exports reaching $15.4 billion. <<> In the area of people's livelihoods, he stated that efforts have continued to revitalize the economy and support the stability of people's lives through measures such as consumption coupons for economic recovery and subsidies for those affected by high oil prices. <<> However, Chief Kang emphasized that the government should not become complacent with current achievements. He ordered that, as the government enters its second year, changes that the public can feel should be implemented swiftly. In particular, he ordered a review of bills that failed to pass the National Assembly and delayed national tasks. item.title: People Power Party Resolves to File Election Appeals in Five Regions Including Seoul at Emergency Supreme Council (국힘, 긴급 최고위서 “서울 등 5개 지역 선거 소청” 의결)
item.description:
People Power Party Resolves to File Election Appeals in Five Regions Including Seoul at Emergency Supreme Council (국힘, 긴급 최고위서 “서울 등 5개 지역 선거 소청” 의결)

The People Power Party decided on the 15th to file election appeals regarding the elections in five regions where ballot shortages occurred during the June 3 local elections: Seoul, Incheon, Gyeonggi, Gwangju/Jeonnam, and Ulsan. An election appeal is a procedure to contest the validity of an election or the validity of a candidate's election with the National Election Commission. (국민의힘이 15일 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태가 벌어진 서울, 인천, 경기, 광주·전남, 울산 등 5개 지역의 선거에 대해 선거소청을 내기로 했다. 선거소청은 선거의 효력이나 당선 효력에 대해 선거관리위원회에 불복을 제기하는 절차다.)

Senior Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon announced that the People Power Party held an emergency Supreme Council meeting in the afternoon and resolved on this matter. The scope of the targeted elections includes six types: heads of regional and basic local governments, regional and basic council members, and regional and basic proportional representation council members. (국민의힘은 이날 오후 긴급 최고위원회를 열고 이 같은 내용을 의결했다고 최보윤 수석대변인이 밝혔다. 대상 선거 범위는 광역·기초단체장, 광역·기초의원, 광역·기초비례의원 등 6개 선거다.)

Senior Spokesperson Choi stated, "The right to file a re-election appeal belongs to the party leader," and added, "There was an urgent need for a decision because the deadline for filing appeals is this Wednesday (the 17th)." The deadline for filing election appeals regarding the June 3 local elections is until the 17th. (최 수석대변인은 “재선거 소청권자는 당대표”라며 “소청 기한이 이번 주 수요일(17일)까지라 급하게 결정돼야 하는 부분이 있었다”고 했다. 지난 6·3 지방선거 선거소청 제기 기한은 오는 17일까지다.)

This election appeal comes amid growing calls nationwide for re-elections. The current Public Official Election Act stipulates that an election can be declared invalid only when it is deemed to have affected the election results. Whether the ballot shortage caused a 'voter sentiment error significant enough to alter the election outcome' is expected to be the criterion determining the possibility of a re-election. (이번 선거소청은 전국적으로 재선거 주장이 커지는 가운데 나왔다. 현행 공직선거법은 ‘선거 결과에 영향을 미쳤다고 인정하는 때’에만 선거 무효를 결정하도록 하고 있다. 투표 용지 부족으로 ‘선거 결과를 바꿀 정도의 표심 오류’가 발생했는지가 재선거 가능 여부를 가르는 기준이 될 전망이다.)

The election appeal is a necessary procedure to seek confirmation of whether the ballot shortage incident affected the results of each election. Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik, speaking to reporters after the Supreme Council meeting, said, "We are requesting an examination of whether the ballot shortages at some polling stations affected the election results." (이번 투표지 부족 사태가 각 선거 결과에 영향을 미쳤는지를 확인받기 위해 필요한 절차가 선거소청이다. 정점식 원내대표는 최고위 이후 기자들과 만나 “일부 투표소에서 발생한 투표지 부족 사태가 선거 결과에 영향을 미쳤는지를 심사해 달라고 하는 것”이라고 했다.)

The National Election Commission must make a decision within 60 days from the date of receiving the election appeal. If the commission accepts the appeal, a re-election will be conducted within 30 days from the date of notification of the decision. (선관위는 선거소청을 접수한 날로부터 60일 내 결정을 내려야 한다. 선관위가 소청을 받아들이면 결정 통지일로부터 30일 이내 재선거가 실시된다.)

The meeting on this day was held to address the issue of filing election appeals with the National Election Commission regarding the elections in regions where ballot shortages occurred during the June 3 local elections. Attendees included Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik, and Supreme Council members Shin Dong-wook, Kim Min-soo, Yang Hyang-ja, and Jo Gwang-han. <<>> (이날 회의는 6·3 지방선거 당시 투표용지 부족 사태가 벌어진 지역의 선거에 대해 중앙선거관리위원회에 선거소청하는 문제를 놓고 열렸다. 장동혁 대표와 정점식 원내대표, 신동욱·김민수·양향자·조광한 최고위원 등이 참석했다.)

item.title: Jeonbuk Education Superintendent Election: 1,104 Votes Omitted, Police and Election Commission Investigation Underway (전북교육감 선거 1104표 누락 사태, 경찰 선관위 조사)
item.description:
Jeonbuk Education Superintendent Election: 1,104 Votes Omitted, Police and Election Commission Investigation Underway (전북교육감 선거 1104표 누락 사태, 경찰 선관위 조사)

In connection with the omission of votes from 1,104 voters during the vote counting process for the 9th local election for Jeonbuk’s superintendent of education, police have launched an investigation into the Jeonbuk Election Commission. <<> On the 15th, according to the Jeonbuk Provincial Police Agency, police summoned and questioned employees of the Jeonju Wansan-gu Election Commission who were responsible for the error in recording voting records. It is reported that the police investigated the factual circumstances, including the vote counting process at the time and the circumstances of the computer data entry. <<> The vote omission incident originated from incorrectly recording the voting record of the 3rd polling station in Junghwasan 1-dong, Wansan-gu, Jeonju, as the "1st polling station." Vote counting personnel failed to catch this mistake and improperly entered the results of the 3rd polling station into the computer as the results of the 1st polling station. As a result, the voting results of 1,104 voters from the 1st polling station were entirely omitted from the final tally, and the results of the 3rd polling station were erroneously counted twice. <<> Even if the omitted votes are properly reflected, the outcome of the elected candidate does not change. However, the final vote gap between the elected Jeonbuk education superintendent, Cheon Ho-seong, and candidate Lee Nam-ho will decrease from the original 118,644 votes to 118,625 votes, a reduction of 19 votes. <<> The Election Commission's "delayed reporting" after the incident has also come under fire. The Wansan-gu Election Commission identified the error early in the morning on the 4th during the vote counting, but only confirmed the omission on the 5th, after all counting was completed. Furthermore, the relevant information was officially reported to Jeonbuk Election Commission Chairperson Kim Sang-gon only on the 9th, five days later. <<> In response, Chairperson Kim Sang-gon bowed his head to the provincial residents on the 11th, saying, "We are deeply sorry." Regarding the reason for the delayed action, Chairperson Kim explained, "If we had arbitrarily modified the computer data simply due to some error, the act itself could have sparked suspicions of election fraud," adding, "It was necessary to accurately grasp the situation and proceed through procedures free of doubt before making corrections." <<> The Jeonbuk Election Commission has acknowledged the seriousness of this incident and promised to prepare measures to prevent recurrence, including overhauling the voting record preparation system. Additionally, it plans to convene a committee meeting to decide on correcting the erroneously recorded vote-count results in the election records, and after informing all candidates in detail about the circumstances of the error, it will seek approval from the National Election Commission to make a final correction of the results in the election statistics system. (제9회 지방선거 전북도교육감 개표 과정에서 발생한 유권자 1104명의 득표수 누락 사태와 관련해 경찰이 전북선거관리위원회를 상대로 조사에 나섰다.)

item.title: President Lee Meets Pope, Requests Mediation Role in Inter-Korean Relations (李대통령, 교황 만나 ‘남북관계 중재역’ 요청)
item.description:
President Lee Meets Pope, Requests Mediation Role in Inter-Korean Relations (李대통령, 교황 만나 ‘남북관계 중재역’ 요청)

President Lee Jae-myung, currently on an official visit to the Vatican, reportedly met with Pope Leo XIV at the Vatican on the 15th (local time) and formally requested that the Pope visit North Korea to help resolve inter-Korean issues. While officially inviting the Pope to the World Youth Congress to be held in Seoul next year, he asked that, on the occasion of the visit to South Korea, the Pope also travel to North Korea to play a role in fostering peace on the Korean Peninsula. (바티칸을 공식 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 15일(현지 시각) 교황청에서 교황 레오 14세를 만나 남북 문제 해결을 위해 북한을 방문해 달라고 공식 요청한 것으로 알려졌다. 내년 서울에서 개최되는 세계청년대회에 교황을 공식 초청하면서, 방한 계기에 방북해 한반도 평화를 위한 역할을 해달라고 요청했다는 것이다.)

Wi Sung-lac, head of the Office of National Security at the presidential office, stated in a briefing after the meeting between President Lee and the Pope, "The President conveyed to the Pope the aspirations of our people for peace on the Korean Peninsula and the vision of our government, reaffirming the unwavering support and interest of the Vatican in peace and reconciliation on the Korean Peninsula." A senior presidential official said, "I understand that discussions were held on measures to improve inter-Korean relations," adding, "The President expressed expectations for the Catholic Church's contribution and role in the peace and stability of the Korean Peninsula, and I heard the Pope responded positively to that." (위성락 청와대 국가안보실장은 이 대통령과 교황의 면담 뒤 브리핑에서 “대통령은 교황에게 한반도 평화 정착에 대한 우리 국민의 염원과 우리 정부의 구상에 대해 말하고 교황청의 한반도 평화·화해를 위한 변함없는 지지와 관심을 재확인했다”고 말했다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 “면담에서 남북 관계 개선을 위한 방안들이 논의된 것으로 들었다”며 “대통령이 한반도의 평화와 안정에 대한 천주교의 기여와 역할에 대해 기대를 표했고, 이에 대해서 교황이 호응하는 말이 있었다고 들었다”고 했다.)

The meeting between President Lee and the Pope lasted nearly 30 minutes, held alone without any aides present. President Lee expressed gratitude for the Catholic Church's significant contributions to Korea's modernization and democratization, while requesting the Church's role in peace on the Korean Peninsula. Given that the Pope is expected to attend the Seoul World Youth Congress in August next year, President Lee asked for the Pope to play an active role. A senior presidential official stated, "Messages from the Pope or the Vatican regarding reconciliation and peace on the Korean Peninsula are important," adding, "If the Pope delivers such a message during his visit to Korea at the World Youth Congress, it would be helpful." (이 대통령과 교황의 면담은 이날 배석자 없이 단독으로 30분 가까이 이뤄졌다. 이 대통령은 한국의 근대화, 민주화 과정에서 천주교의 기여가 컸다고 감사를 표하면서, 한반도 평화에서도 천주교의 역할을 요청했다. 교황이 내년 8월 서울 세계청년대회에 참석할 것으로 예상되는 만큼, 교황이 적극적인 역할을 해주길 부탁했다는 것이다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 “교황이나 교황청이 발신하는 한반도 화해·평화에 대한 메시지가 중요하다”며 “교황의 방한 때 세계청년대회에서 그런 메시지를 발신한다면 도움이 될 것”이라고 했다.)

Following the meeting with the Pope, President Lee also met with Pietro Parolin, the Vatican's Secretary of State, to discuss inter-Korean issues. The senior official reported that President Lee, while acknowledging that relations between North and South Korea are currently severed and difficult, expressed determination to persevere and work hard, quoting the biblical phrase, "Knock, and it will be opened to you." In response, the Vatican side reportedly agreed on the need for patience and replied, "Not only patience but hope is needed." (이 대통령은 교황에 이어 피에트로 파롤린 교황청 국무원장과도 만나 남북 문제 등을 논의했다. 이 대통령은 남북이 지금은 단절되어 어렵지만 인내하고 노력하겠다면서 성경에 나오는 ‘두드려라, 그러면 열릴 것이다’라는 문구를 인용했다고 고위 관계자는 전했다. 이에 교황청 측에서도 인내가 필요할 것이라는 데 공감했고 ‘인내뿐만 아니라 희망이 필요하다’고 답했다고 한다.)

Regarding the possibility of the Pope visiting North Korea, Cardinal Yu Heung-sik, a Vatican official, said during a meeting with reporters the previous day, "North Korea needs to invite (the Pope) and create the conditions," adding, "It depends on North Korea." Mentioning that the Pope is American, Cardinal Yu also said, "I think he might be able to play a role in opening up U.S.-North Korea relations (compared to a Pope from another country)." Cardinal Yu stated that he had spoken with the Pope about his role in peace on the Korean Peninsula and said, "The Pope smiled and said, 'How wonderful it would be if I could play a role too.'" (교황의 방북 가능성과 관련해, 교황청 장관인 유흥식 추기경은 전날 취재진과 만나 “북한이 (교황을) 초청하고 여건을 만들어야 된다”며 “북한에 달려 있는 것”이라고 말했다. 유 추기경은 교황이 미국인이라는 점을 언급하며 “(다른 국가 출신 교황에 비해) 북미 관계를 트는 데 역할을 할 수 있지 않을까 생각이 든다”고도 했다. 유 추기경은 교황과 한반도 평화를 위한 역할에 대해 대화한 적이 있다며 “교황님도 웃으며 ‘나도 역할을 할 수 있으면 얼마나 좋겠느냐’고 말했다”고 했다.)

Cardinal Yu said, "I meet with the Pope about once every two months," adding, "All (of Korea's) political and economic situations have changed, and I have been continuously informing him of those circumstances, so the Pope is well aware of the situation." Regarding the meeting between President Lee and the Pope, Cardinal Yu remarked, "I'm not sure if this is the right expression, but I think the two will get along very well," and expressed hope that "President Lee receives strength from the Pope. If he gains strength from the Pope, it could actually enhance his international standing." (유 추기경은 “2개월에 한 번 정도는 교황을 뵙게 된다”며 “(한국의) 정치·경제 등 모든 상황이 바뀌었고 그런 상황을 계속 말씀드렸기 때문에, 교황님도 상황을 잘 알고 계시다”고 했다. 유 추기경은 이 대통령과 교황의 만남에 대해 “표현이 맞는지 모르겠지만, 두 분이 죽이 잘 맞으실 것 같다”면서 “대통령님이 교황님한테 힘을 받았으면 좋겠다. 교황님한테 힘을 받으면 실제로 국제적인 위상도 좀 높아진다”고 했다.)

On this day, President Lee gifted the Pope a sculpture titled "God's Bosom," which embodies the biblical story of the Prodigal Son, along with a white porcelain multi-purpose container. To Secretary of State Parolin, he presented premium red ginseng extract. (이 대통령은 이날 교황에게 성경 속 ‘돌아온 탕아’ 이야기를 형상화해 ‘하느님의 품’이라는 이름을 붙인 조각상, 백자 다용도 합을 선물했다. 파롤린 국무원장에게는 프리미엄 홍삼 달임액 등을 선물했다.)

President Lee will move to Évian, France, where the G7 summit is to be held on the 16th. There is interest in whether a meeting will take place with U.S. President Donald Trump, who will be attending the G7 summit, but a senior presidential official stated, "We are keeping the possibility open, but it is difficult to say there has been specific progress (in consultations with the U.S.)," adding, "It is not a topic we are focusing on promoting." This implies that the main objectives of this European tour and attendance at the G7 summit are to strengthen relations with key European Union (EU) countries. <<>> (이 대통령은 16일 G7 정상회의가 열리는 프랑스 에비앙으로 이동한다. G7 정상회의에 참석하는 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 회담이 이뤄질지 여부에 관심이 모이지만, 청와대 고위 관계자는 “가능성을 열어두고 있지만 (미국과 협의에) 구체적인 진전이 있다고 보기는 어렵다”며 “우리가 주안점을 두고 추진하는 주제는 아니다”라고 했다. 이번 유럽 순방과 G7 정상회의 참석의 주요한 목적은 유럽연합(EU) 주요국과의 관계 강화에 있다는 의미다.)

item.title: President Lee Welcomes Middle East Negotiation Breakthrough… "Will Play Role for Free and Safe Navigation in the Strait of Hormuz" (李대통령, 중동 협상 타결 환영… “호르무즈 해협 자유롭고 안전한 항행 위해 역할 다할 것”)
item.description:
President Lee Welcomes Middle East Negotiation Breakthrough… "Will Play Role for Free and Safe Navigation in the Strait of Hormuz" (李대통령, 중동 협상 타결 환영… “호르무즈 해협 자유롭고 안전한 항행 위해 역할 다할 것”)

President Lee Jae-myung, currently on a European tour, expressed his welcome on the 15th (local time) regarding the conclusion of negotiations related to the Middle East. He also highly praised the leadership of U.S. President Donald Trump, who facilitated this agreement, and the diplomatic efforts of the relevant countries. (유럽을 순방 중인 이재명 대통령이 15일(현지 시각) 중동 관련 협상이 타결된 것에 대해 환영의 뜻을 밝혔다. 이번 합의를 이끌어낸 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령의 리더십과 관련국들의 외교적 노력을 높이 평가하기도 했다.)

President Lee stated through X (formerly Twitter), "I welcome the conclusion of Middle East-related negotiations," adding, "This is a significant step forward in resolving a situation that the international community has long anticipated." He further said, "I highly commend President Trump's leadership in leading this negotiation to a conclusion and the diplomatic efforts of the negotiating parties and related countries." He also conveyed his hope that this agreement would lead to the swift restoration of peace and stability in the Middle East region, establishing a foundation for the safety and prosperity of local residents. (이 대통령은 X(옛 트위터)를 통해 “중동 관련 협상이 타결된 것을 환영한다”며 “이는 국제사회가 오랫동안 기대해 온 사태 해결을 위한 중요한 진전”이라고 했다. 이어 “이번 협상 타결을 이끌어낸 트럼프 대통령의 리더십과 협상 당사국 및 관련국들의 외교적 노력을 높이 평가한다”고 했다. 이번 합의를 통해 중동 지역의 평화와 안정이 조속히 회복되고, 역내 주민들의 안전과 번영을 위한 기반이 마련되기를 기대한다는 뜻도 함께 전했다.)

President Lee emphasized, "I hope that global energy supply and demand will stabilize, and that all vessels, including our ships and seafarers who have faced restrictions on navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, can resume safe operations as soon as possible." He added, "The resulting rise in energy prices and logistics costs has placed a significant burden on domestic prices, corporate management, and the overall daily lives of citizens. Although it may be difficult to feel changes in the short term, I expect that uncertainties in our economy will gradually be resolved, providing an opportunity for recovery." (이 대통령은 “글로벌 에너지 수급이 안정화되고, 그간 호르무즈 해협 항행에 제약을 받아온 우리 선박과 선원들을 포함한 모든 선박이 조속히 안전한 운항을 재개할 수 있길 바란다”고 강조했다. 이어 “에너지 가격과 물류비 상승을 초래하며 국내 물가와 기업 경영, 일상생활 전반에 상당한 부담으로 작용해 왔다”며 “단기간 내 변화를 체감하긴 어렵겠지만, 우리 경제의 불확실성이 점차 해소되며 회복의 계기가 마련되길 기대한다”고 했다.)

Finally, President Lee made clear his commitment to continuing cooperation with the international community to ensure safe navigation in the future. President Lee stated, "As a responsible member of the international community, the Republic of Korea will not spare necessary support and cooperation to ensure that this agreement contributes to world peace and prosperity beyond the Middle East region." He added, "We will closely coordinate with the international community, including the United States, and carry out necessary roles to ensure that free and safe navigation through the Strait of Hormuz is continuously guaranteed going forward." (마지막으로 이 대통령은 향후 안전한 항행 보장을 위해 국제사회와 공조를 지속하겠다는 의지를 분명히 했다. 이 대통령은 “대한민국은 국제사회의 책임 있는 일원으로서, 이번 합의가 중동 지역을 넘어 세계 평화와 번영에 기여할 수 있도록 필요한 지원과 협력을 아끼지 않겠다”고 했다. 이어 “앞으로도 호르무즈 해협에서의 자유롭고 안전한 항행이 지속적으로 보장될 수 있도록 미국을 비롯한 국제사회와 긴밀히 공조하며 필요한 역할을 수행해 나가겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: Office Chief Who Self-Approved Fake Sick Leave… Employees Also Received Golf and Travel Entertainment (허위병가 셀프 결재한 사무국장… 골프·여행 접대 받은 직원들도)
item.description:
Office Chief Who Self-Approved Fake Sick Leave… Employees Also Received Golf and Travel Entertainment (허위병가 셀프 결재한 사무국장… 골프·여행 접대 받은 직원들도)

A Grade 6 employee, identified as A, of the Daegu Jung-gu Election Commission was under audit after a video emerged on the evening of the 9th showing him practicing golf swings on the office staircase. At the time, a protest was being held outside the office building over issues like the "ballot shortage incident," and A had applied for overtime work for which allowances would be paid. Although the election commission's organizational culture faced strong criticism due to "nepotism hiring irregularities" that surfaced in 2023, it appears lax discipline persists. (대구 중구 선관위의 6급 직원 A씨는 지난 9일 저녁 청사 계단에서 골프 스윙 연습을 하는 영상이 공개돼 감사를 받고 있다. 당시 청사 밖에서는 ‘투표용지 부족 사태’ 등에 항의하는 집회가 열리고 있었고, A씨는 수당이 지급되는 시간 외 근무를 신청한 상태였다. 2023년 불거진 ‘친인척 특혜 채용 비리’ 등으로 선관위의 조직 문화가 강한 비판을 받았지만, 기강 해이는 여전하다는 지적이 나온다.)

According to disciplinary records submitted by the National Election Commission (NEC) on the 15th to the office of People Power Party lawmaker Kim Seung-su, there were a total of 125 disciplinary actions from 2021 to last April. These included 3 cases in 2021, 27 in 2022, 7 in 2023, 41 in 2024, 42 last year, and 5 cases up to April this year. The 2022 tally included disciplinary actions related to the "ballot box manipulation incident" during the presidential election, while the 2024 figure included actions over vote-counting errors during the general election. (선관위가 15일 국민의힘 김승수 의원실에 제출한 징계 현황을 보면, 2021년부터 지난 4월까지 총 125건의 징계 처분이 있었다. 2021년 3건, 2022년 27건, 2023년 7건, 2024년 41건, 작년 42건, 올해는 4월까지 5건이었다. 2022년에는 대선 소쿠리 투표, 2024년에는 총선 개표 오류 관련 징계가 포함됐다.)

By reason for discipline, the most common was personnel and hiring misconduct with 18 cases, followed by 15 cases of drunk driving and 15 cases of sexual misconduct. For instance, a Grade 6 employee of the election commission, intoxicated last August, hugged a victim without reason as they were leaving a bar, committing sexual assault, and received a "reprimand" penalty this February. (징계 사유별로 보면 가장 많은 18건이 인사·채용 비위였다. 음주 운전 관련 15건, 성 비위 15건이 그 뒤를 이었다. 일례로 선관위의 한 6급 직원은 지난해 8월 술에 취해 술집에서 나오고 있던 피해자를 아무 이유 없이 껴안으며 강제 추행해 올 2월 ‘견책’ 징계를 받았다.)

The lax discipline within the election commission was starkly revealed during an audit by the Board of Audit and Inspection (BAI). In 2023, the BAI uncovered employees of city, county, and district election commissions who had received expenses for golf and overseas trips from affiliated election commissioners, or accepted amounts between 100,000 won and 900,000 won under the guise of farewell gifts and holiday bonuses. (선관위의 기강 해이는 감사원 감사에서도 적나라하게 드러났다. 2023년 감사원은 소속 기관 선관위원으로부터 골프·해외 여행 경비를 받거나, 전별금·명절기념금 명목으로 10만~90만원을 받은 시·군·구 선관위 직원들을 적발했다.)

In February last year, the BAI announced the discovery of an election commission employee who, from March 2015 to September 2023—a period of 8 years and 6 months—had been absent without leave for 100 days while being processed as working normally, and had submitted fake sick leave for 81 days. This employee claimed to be caring for his mother but actually traveled to Japan and other places, and while serving as the office chief of a city election commission, used methods like "self-approving vacation" to leave the country 124 times during this period, staying in seven countries including Japan for a total of 817 days. (작년 2월 감사원은 2015년 3월부터 2023년 9월까지 8년 6개월 동안 100일이나 무단결근을 했으면서도 정상 근무처럼 처리하고, 81일간 허위 병가를 쓴 선관위 직원을 적발했다고 발표했다. 이 직원은 모친 간병을 하겠다면서 실제로는 일본에 가거나, 시 선관위 사무국장으로 일하면서 ‘셀프 휴가 승인’을 하는 등의 방법으로 이 기간 124차례 출국해 일본 등 7국에 817일 간 체류했다.)

The BAI also uncovered a case in March 2018 where the Jeonbuk Election Commission approved a Grade 7 employee's two-year study leave to attend law school. The Jeonbuk Election Commission is the same body that committed a "vote-counting error" during the recent Jeonbuk Education Superintendent election, misinputting the vote tally from one polling station as the result from another. (감사원은 2018년 3월 전북 선관위가 한 7급 직원이 로스쿨에 진학할 수 있도록 2년간의 연수 휴직을 승인해 준 사례를 적발하기도 했다. 전북 선관위는 이번 전북교육감 선거에서 한 투표소의 개표 결과를 다른 투표소의 결과로 잘못 입력하는 ‘개표 오류’를 낸 곳이다.)

However, following a Constitutional Court ruling in February last year that "the National Election Commission is an independent constitutional institution, not an administrative agency, and thus not subject to the BAI's work inspections," the BAI lost the authority to audit the NEC. Just after NEC's hiring privilege suspicions emerged in June 2023, the BAI began an audit of its personnel management practices, leading the NEC to file a jurisdictional dispute with the Constitutional Court, arguing that the audit infringed on its independent operational authority. The court ruled in favor of the NEC. (하지만 지난해 2월 헌법재판소가 “중앙선관위는 행정기관이 아닌 독립된 헌법기관이며, 감사원의 직무 감찰 대상이 아니다”라고 판결함에 따라 감사원은 선관위를 감사할 수 없게 됐다. 선관위 특혜 채용 의혹이 불거진 직후인 2023년 6월 감사원이 인력 관리 실태에 대한 감사에 착수하자, 선관위는 “감사원 감사는 독립적 업무 수행권을 침해한다”며 헌재에 권한쟁의 심판을 냈고 헌재가 선관위 손을 들어준 것이다.)

item.title: Lee Orders Strict Investigation into Jamsil Blockade Protests, Citing Obstruction Including Restriction of Civilian Access (李, 잠실 봉쇄 시위에 “민간인 출입제한 등 업무 방해 엄중 수사”)
item.description:
Lee Orders Strict Investigation into Jamsil Blockade Protests, Citing Obstruction Including Restriction of Civilian Access (李, 잠실 봉쇄 시위에 “민간인 출입제한 등 업무 방해 엄중 수사”)

President Lee Jae-myung, currently visiting Europe, stated on the 15th (local time) on X (formerly Twitter) regarding the protests at the Seoul Jamsil Olympic Park vote-counting station sparked by a ballot shortage: "I have instructed the police to conduct a rigorous investigation into obstruction by force, including the protesters' misconduct of restricting civilian access, and to hold both the perpetrators and conspirators accountable." (유럽을 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 15일(현지 시각) X(엑스·옛 트위터)에서 투표용지 부족 사태로 촉발된 서울 잠실 올림픽공원 개표소 시위와 관련해 “시위대의 민간인 출입제한 행패 등 위력에 의한 업무 방해에 대해 행위자는 물론 공모자에 대해 엄정 수사를 경찰에 지시했다”고 말했다.)

The President remarked, "Protesters must exercise restraint, going beyond expressions of opinion to ensure they do not infringe on the rights of others." He also shared an article detailing that 12 sports organizations, including member groups of the Korean Sport & Olympic Committee housed in the Olympic Park Handball Gymnasium, have been unable to access their offices for ten days due to the building blockade, causing severe operational disruptions. (이 대통령은 “시위대는 의사 표현을 넘어 타인의 권리 침해가 없도록 자제해야 한다”며 이같이 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장에 입주한 대한체육회 회원 종목 단체 등 12개 체육 단체가 시위대의 건물 봉쇄로 인해 열흘째 사무실로 들어가지 못해 극심한 업무 차질을 겪고 있다는 내용의 기사도 공유했다.)

The previous day, while on a state visit to Italy, President Lee presided over a meeting of senior presidential secretaries via video link and called for strong law enforcement. After receiving a report on the situation from the Office of the Senior Secretary for Civil Affairs, he stated, "We fully acknowledge and accept the legitimate grievances of our citizens regarding the infringement of voting rights. However, that is separate. Forces exploiting this to stir up baseless conspiracy theories are rearing their heads again. Spreading claims of election fraud distorts the essence of this issue and insults the valuable voices of the people—it is an anti-social act." (이 대통령은 전날에도 이탈리아 국빈 방문 중 화상으로 청와대 수석보좌관 회의를 주재하며 강력한 법 집행을 주문한 바 있다. 민정수석실로부터 해당 상황을 보고받은 이 대통령은 “참정권 침해에 대한 우리 국민의 정당한 문제 제기를 다 인정하고 수용한다”면서도 “그건 그거고, 이걸 악용해 터무니없는 음모론을 선동하는 세력들이 또 고개를 들고 있다. 부정선거론을 퍼뜨리는 것은 이 문제의 본질을 왜곡하고 국민의 귀한 목소리를 모욕하는 반사회적 행태”라고 했다.)

Police Commissioner General Park Jeong-ho of the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency, during a regular press briefing that day, cited incidents such as the protesters' search of the belongings of the women's youth national handball team at Jamsil, saying, "Because they displayed collective force, we applied charges of special coercion rather than general coercion." He noted that this could lead to imprisonment of up to 10 years. He warned, "The sentence is very severe. If someone thoughtlessly joins in illegal acts on the sidelines and is implicated as an accomplice, it could ruin their life." (박정보 서울경찰청장은 이날 정례 기자간담회에서 잠실 시위대의 핸드볼 여성 유소년 국가대표팀에 대한 소지품 수색 사건 등을 언급하며 “다중의 위력을 과시했기 때문에 일반 강요 혐의가 아닌 특수 강요를 적용했다”고 했다. 그러면서 10년 이하의 징역이 가능하다고 했다. 이어 “굉장히 형량이 높다”며 “아무 생각 없이 옆에서 불법 행위에 동조했다가 공범으로 적용될 경우에는 패가망신할 수 있다”고 경고했다.)

Meanwhile, the Jeonbuk Provincial Police Agency launched an investigation that day into the Jeonbuk Provincial Election Commission regarding the omission of votes for 1,104 voters during the counting process for the Jeonbuk Superintendent of Education election. Police reportedly summoned employees of the Wansan-gu Election Commission in Jeonju City to investigate the counting process and computer entry procedures at the time. The vote omission incident stemmed from incorrectly recording the polling log for the 3rd polling station in Junghwasan 1-dong, Wansan-gu, Jeonju, as the '1st polling station.' (한편, 전북경찰청은 이날 전북도교육감 선거 개표 과정에서 발생한 유권자 1104명의 득표수 누락 사태와 관련해 전북선거관리위원회를 상대로 조사에 나섰다. 경찰은 전주시 완산구선거관리위원회 직원들을 불러 당시 개표 과정과 전산 입력 경위 등을 조사한 것으로 알려졌다. 득표수 누락 사태는 전주시 완산구 중화산1동 제3투표소의 투표록을 ‘제1투표소’로 잘못 기재하면서 비롯됐다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk Files Election Appeals in Six Regions Including Seoul… "Goal is a Nationwide Re-election" (장동혁, 서울 등 6곳 선거 소청… “목표는 전국 재선거”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk Files Election Appeals in Six Regions Including Seoul… "Goal is a Nationwide Re-election" (장동혁, 서울 등 6곳 선거 소청… “목표는 전국 재선거”)

On the 15th, the People Power Party decided to file an election appeal with the National Election Commission regarding the elections in regions where ballot shortages occurred during the June 3 local elections. An election appeal is a procedure to challenge the validity of an election or the validity of an election win. In political circles, it is said that Representative Jang Dong-hyuk is using the response to the ballot shortage crisis to overcome calls for his resignation. (국민의힘이 15일 6·3 지방선거 당시 투표용지 부족 사태가 벌어진 지역의 선거에 대해 선거관리위원회에 선거소청을 내기로 했다. 선거소청은 선거의 효력이나 당선 효력에 대해 이의를 제기하는 절차다. 정치권에선 장동혁 대표가 투표용지 부족 사태 대응을 앞세워 자신에 대한 사퇴론을 돌파하려 한다는 이야기가 나온다.)

The People Power Party held an emergency Supreme Council meeting in the afternoon and voted on the election appeal agenda. Choi Bo-yoon, the senior spokesperson for the People Power Party, said, "Since the deadline for the appeal is Wednesday (the 17th), we went through the Supreme Council discussion without holding a general meeting of party lawmakers." The targeted regions for the election appeal primarily include six areas—Seoul, Incheon, Gyeonggi, Gwangju-Jeonnam, Ulsan, and Busan—covering elections for metropolitan and basic government heads, metropolitan and basic council members, and metropolitan and basic proportional council members. A party official stated, "Beyond the six regions, we plan to file election appeals in all areas where the ballot shortage occurred." This would include Daegu, North Chungcheong, North Jeolla, and South Gyeongnam. (국민의힘은 이날 오후 긴급 최고위원 회의를 열고 선거소청 안건을 의결했다. 최보윤 국민의힘 수석대변인은 “소청 기한이 수요일(17일)까지여서 의원총회를 거치지 않고 최고위 논의를 거쳤다”고 했다. 선거소청 대상 지역은 일차적으로 서울, 인천, 경기, 광주전남, 울산, 부산 등 6곳의 광역·기초단체장, 광역·기초의원, 광역·기초비례의원 선거다. 당 관계자는 “6개 지역 외에도 투표용지 사태가 벌어진 모든 지역에서 선거소청을 낼 예정”이라고 말했다. 이 경우 대구, 충북, 전북, 경남이 포함된다.)

Once an election appeal is filed, the National Election Commission will examine whether there were serious violations in the election process and whether these affected the election outcome, deciding whether to uphold the appeal within 60 days. If the commission accepts the appeal, a re-election will be held within 30 days. If the commission decides to dismiss or reject the appeal, the appellant can file an election lawsuit in court within 10 days. The current Public Official Election Act stipulates that election invalidation is determined only when it is recognized that the issue affected the election result. The Reform Party also submitted election appeal documents on the same day for 18 cases, including the Seoul, Incheon, Daegu, and Gyeonggi provincial governor elections. (선거소청이 접수되면 선관위는 선거 과정에 중대한 위법이 있었는지, 이것이 선거 결과에 영향을 미쳤는지를 확인해 60일 이내 인용 여부를 결정한다. 만약 선관위가 소청을 받아들이면 30일 내 재선거가 실시된다. 선관위가 기각이나 각하 결정을 내리면 선거소청 제기자는 10일 내 법원에 선거소송을 제기할 수 있다. 현행 공직선거법은 ‘선거 결과에 영향을 미쳤다고 인정하는 때’에만 선거무효를 결정하도록 하고 있다. 개혁신당도 이날 서울, 인천, 대구, 경기 시·도지사 선거 등 18건에 대해 선거소청장을 제출했다.)

However, differences in perspective emerged within the leadership over the election appeal. Representative Jang wrote on Facebook that evening, "The goal is clear: a nationwide re-election. The appeal is just the beginning." In contrast, floor leader Chung Joon-sik told reporters after the Supreme Council meeting, "We are asking for a review of whether the ballot shortages at some polling stations in the six regions affected the results of each election. It is not a demand for a full re-election." (하지만 선거 소청을 두고 지도부 간에 시각차가 드러났다. 장 대표는 이날 밤 자신의 페이스북에 “목표는 분명하다. 전국 재선거”라며 “소청은 시작일 뿐”이라고 했다. 반면 정점식 원내대표는 최고위 직후 기자들과 만나 “6개 지역 일부 투표소에서 발생한 투표지 부족 사태가 각 선거 결과에 영향을 미쳤는지를 심사해 달라고 하는 것”이라며 “전면 재선거 요구가 아니다”라고 했다.)

Many in the legal community responded that the Election Commission is unlikely to uphold the election appeal. On the 4th, the National Election Commission had already stated that the ballot shortage "does not constitute grounds for postponing an election or holding a re-election under the Public Official Election Act." If the appeal is dismissed and Representative Jang files an election lawsuit, internal party conflict could become prolonged. Lawmaker Kim Yong-tae, who has been urging Representative Jang to resign, said, "I am quite taken aback that the party leader decided this through the Supreme Council without consulting party lawmakers." (법조계에선 선관위가 선거소청 인용 결정을 내릴 가능성은 적다는 반응이 많다. 중앙선관위는 지난 4일 이미 투표용지 부족 사태가 “공직선거법에 따른 선거의 연기나 재선거 사유에 해당하지 않는다”고 밝혔다. 선거소청이 기각돼 장 대표가 선거 소송을 제기할 경우 당내 분란이 장기화될 가능성도 있다. 장 대표 사퇴를 촉구해 온 김용태 의원은 이날 “당 소속 의원들과 논의 없이 당 대표께서 최고위를 통해 (선거 소청을) 결정한 것에 굉장히 좀 당황스럽다”고 했다.)

The emergency Supreme Council meeting, which was not on the schedule, was convened on Representative Jang Dong-hyuk’s decision. Within the party, some speculated, "Since the resignation issue erupted publicly again at the morning Supreme Council meeting, wasn’t this orchestrated to defuse it through re-election discussions?" At the morning Supreme Council meeting, Supreme Council member Yang Hyang-ja stated, "Politics is ultimately about responsibility, and leaders are those who take responsibility. I propose the entire leadership resign." This occurred four days after Supreme Council member Woo Jae-joon proposed a collective resignation on the 11th. If four of the five elected Supreme Council members (Kim Min-soo, Shin Dong-wook, Kim Jae-won, Yang Hyang-ja, and Woo Jae-joon) resign, the party leadership would dissolve and transition to an emergency committee system. (이날 예정에 없던 긴급 최고위는 장동혁 대표의 결정으로 소집됐다. 당내에선 “오전 최고위원 회의에서 사퇴 문제가 공개적으로 또 터져 나오자 재선거 논의로 이를 무마하기 위한 것 아니냐”는 얘기가 나왔다. 이날 오전 최고위원 회의에서 양향자 최고위원은 “정치는 결국 책임이고, 리더는 책임지는 사람”이라며 “지도부 총사퇴를 제안한다”고 했다. 지난 11일 우재준 최고위원이 총사퇴를 제안한 지 나흘 만이다. 선출직 최고위원 5명(김민수·신동욱·김재원·양향자·우재준) 중 4명이 사퇴하면 당 지도부가 해산하고 비상대책위원회 체제로 전환된다.)

In response, Representative Jang said, "Describing the People Power Party leadership as zombies is an insult to the people who gave us their support." It was reported that during the closed-door meeting, criticism and complaints were directed at Supreme Council members Yang Hyang-ja and Woo Jae-joon, who had insisted on the leadership's resignation. Woo Jae-joon did not attend the meeting as he was abroad. Park Jun-tae, the chief of staff for Representative Jang, told reporters after the Supreme Council meeting, "If someone feels they should take responsibility, they can resign or take responsibility on their own." (그러자 장 대표는 “국민의힘 지도부를 좀비라고 표현하는 것은 그 지지를 보내주신 국민들을 모욕하는 것”이라고 했다. 비공개 회의에서도 지도부 사퇴를 주장한 양향자·우재준 최고위원에 대한 불만과 비판이 쏟아진 것으로 전해졌다. 우 최고위원은 해외 체류 중이어서 회의에 참석하지 않았다. 장 대표 측근인 박준태 당대표 비서실장은 최고위 이후 기자들과 만나 “본인이 책임져야겠다고 생각하면 스스로 사퇴하거나 책임지면 된다”고 했다.)

People Power Party lawmakers plan to hold a general meeting on the 17th or 18th to discuss the fate of Representative Jang and the leadership. Among the 110 lawmakers, 25 members of the "Alternative and Future" faction have called for Representative Jang's resignation, and some senior lawmakers believe, "We need to hold party meetings several times to secure Representative Jang's decision to resign." However, a significant number of lawmakers from the Yeongnam region hold the view, "What will be solved if Representative Jang steps down?" A political insider commented, "For lawmakers, nominations for the 2028 general election are the most important thing, but since there's still plenty of time, many are just watching from the sidelines." (국민의힘 의원들은 17일 내지 18일 의원총회를 열고 장 대표를 비롯한 지도부 거취 문제에 대해 논의할 예정이다. 의원 110명 중 ‘대안과 미래’ 소속 25명이 장 대표 사퇴를 요구했고, 일부 중진 의원도 “몇 번이라도 의총을 열어 장 대표의 사퇴 결심을 받아야 한다”고 본다. 하지만 적지 않은 영남권 의원들은 “장 대표가 물러난다고 뭐가 해결되느냐”는 시각이다. 야권 관계자는 “의원들 입장에선 2028년 총선 공천이 제일 중요한데, 아직 시간이 많이 남아 있다 보니 그저 관망하는 사람이 적지 않다”고 했다.)

item.title: U.S. State Department Officials Visiting South Korea Also Meet with Families of Abductees (방한 美국무부 인사들, 납북자 가족들도 면담)
item.description:
U.S. State Department Officials Visiting South Korea Also Meet with Families of Abductees (방한 美국무부 인사들, 납북자 가족들도 면담)

The Korean War Abductee Family Council (the Council) announced on the 15th that visiting U.S. State Department officials met with families of abductees, detainees, and prisoners of war (POWs) from the Korean War, stating that they are "paying attention to enabling families separated by North Korea to reunite." Attention is now focused on whether the United States will strongly demand improvements in North Korea's human rights situation, including the release of detainees of South Korean nationality, if U.S.-North Korea dialogue resumes. (방한한 미국 국무부 인사들이 납북자, 억류자, 국군 포로 가족들을 만나 “북한에 의해 헤어진 가족들이 만날 수 있도록 관심을 기울이고 있다”는 입장을 밝혔다고 6·25전쟁납북인사가족협의회(가족회)가 15일 밝혔다. 앞으로 미·북 대화가 재개될 경우, 미국이 우리 국적의 억류자 석방 문제를 포함한 북한 인권 상황 개선을 강력히 요구할지 주목된다.)

According to the Council, Julie Turner, Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary of the U.S. State Department's Bureau of Democracy, Human Rights, and Labor, and Lindsey Posmanick, a State Department foreign affairs officer, held a meeting with the Council at the U.S. Embassy in Seoul on the 10th. From the South Korean side, participants included Lee Sung-ui, Chairman of the Korean War Abductee Family Council; Choi Sung-ryong, Chairman of the Post-War Abductee Victim Family Association; and Son Myung-hwa, Representative of the Korean War POW Family Association. (가족회에 따르면 줄리 터너 미 국무부 민주주의·인권·노동국 부차관보 대행과 린지 포스매닉 국무부 외교담당관은 지난 10일 주한 미국 대사관에서 가족회와의 면담을 가졌다. 우리 측에서는 6·25전쟁납북인사가족협의회 이성의 이사장, 전후납북피해가족연합회 최성룡 이사장, 6·25국군포로가족회 손명화 대표 등이 참석했다.)

The Council stated during the meeting that "76 years have passed, and not a single family member abducted during the Korean War has returned, nor have we even been able to confirm whether they are alive or dead," adding that "no South Korean government has actively raised or sought to resolve this issue with North Korea." They also emphasized the urgency of the matter, noting that most of the abductee victims or second-generation POWs are over 80 years old. (가족회는 면담에서 “76년이 지나도록 6·25전쟁 중 납북되신 가족 단 한 분도 돌아오시기는커녕 생사조차 확인하지 못하고 있다”며 “대한민국 어떤 정부도 이 문제를 적극적으로 북한에 제기하고 해결하려 하지 않았다”고 했다고 한다. 또 납북 피해자나 국군포로 2세들이 대부분 80세 이상의 고령으로 해결이 시급하다는 점을 강조했다.)

The Council also delivered an open letter requesting that U.S. President Donald Trump directly demand from North Korea the repatriation of South Korean nationals currently detained there, the confirmation of the fate of abductees, and the approval of visits to ancestral graves. Additionally, they requested that if the recovery of remains of U.S. and South Korean soldiers who died in North Korea during the Korean War resumes, it should also include investigations and excavations related to the movement routes or mass burial sites of abductees. The U.S. and North Korea had agreed at the June 2018 Singapore summit to recover and repatriate remains of POWs and those missing in action, but working-level talks were suspended after the breakdown of the February 2019 Hanoi summit. (가족회는 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 현재 북한에 억류 중인 대한민국 국민의 송환, 납북자의 생사 확인, 성묘단 방북 등을 직접 북한에 요구해 달라는 공개 서한도 전달했다. 이어 6·25전쟁 당시 북한 지역에서 전사한 미군·국군 유해 발굴이 재개되면 납북자들의 이동 경로나 집단 매장지에 대한 조사·발굴도 함께 할 수 있게 해달라고 요청했다. 미·북은 2018년 6월 싱가포르 정상회담에서 전쟁포로와 전시 행방불명자의 유해 발굴·송환에 합의했지만 2019년 2월 하노이 정상회담 결렬 후 실무협의가 중단됐다.)

The organizations reported that Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary Turner expressed during the meeting that the U.S. is paying attention to enabling families separated by North Korea—not only Korean Americans but also those worldwide—to reunite. On the 9th, Turner, along with Riley Barnes, Deputy Assistant Secretary of the U.S. State Department's Bureau of Democracy, Human Rights, and Labor, and Belsis Romero, White House Office of Faith-Based and Neighborhood Partnerships liaison, also met with the family of a South Korean missionary who has been detained in North Korea for 12 years. (터너 대행은 이 자리에서 미국 내 한인뿐 아니라, 전 세계에서 북한에 의해 헤어진 가족들이 만날 수 있도록 하는 일에 관심을 기울이고 있다는 뜻을 밝혔다고 단체들은 전했다. 터너 대행은 지난 9일 라일리 반스 미 국무부 민주주의·인권·노동국 차관보, 벨시스 로메로 백악관 신앙사무국 연락관과 함께 12년째 북한에 억류돼 있는 우리 선교사 가족도 면담했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok Called, but Only Half of Provincial Governors-Elect Attended Luncheon (김민석이 불렀지만… 시도지사 당선인들 절반만 오찬에 참석)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok Called, but Only Half of Provincial Governors-Elect Attended Luncheon (김민석이 불렀지만… 시도지사 당선인들 절반만 오찬에 참석)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok hosted a luncheon meeting at his official residence on the 15th for the newly elected provincial governors from the June 3 local elections. Although all 16 governors-elect were invited, all four from the People Power Party, including Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, were absent, and only nine out of 12 from the Democratic Party attended. From the People Power Party, comments emerged saying, "It's unusual for the prime minister to summon governors-elect who haven't even taken office," and "Do we need to go along with a political event ahead of Kim's anticipated August party leadership election?" Kim is reportedly expected to formalize his declaration to run for the Democratic Party's leadership around the end of this month, when the appointment process for Premier-designate Han Sung-sook concludes. <<> Kim held the meeting titled 'Luncheon with Provincial Leaders-Elect on National Transformation' at the prime minister's official residence in Samcheong-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul, at noon on the same day. Kim told the attending governors-elect, "President Lee Jae-myung is on an extended overseas trip right after the election, so I took the initiative to arrange this gathering first." <<> Kim stated, "I organized this meeting to discuss regional balanced development, a long-standing challenge for South Korea," adding, "In the second half of the year, large-scale projects such as selecting regional growth engines under the 'National Spatial Transformation' initiative—President Lee Jae-myung's balanced national development project—and major corporate investments will take shape." He emphasized, "This is not a matter of the central government allocating projects," and "We are thinking of it as the central and local governments working together to change the national spatial structure." During the closed-door luncheon, Kim reportedly asked the attendees to "speak freely about hardships in each region," and the governors-elect offered general opinions on the government's regional development strategies. <<> Among the 12 Democratic Party governors-elect, nine attended, including Gyeonggi Governor-elect Choo Mi-ae, while Busan Mayor-elect Jeon Jae-soo, Gangwon Governor-elect Woo Sang-ho, and South Chungcheong Governor-elect Park Soo-hyun were absent. A ruling party official said, "They were unable to attend due to pre-existing schedules ahead of the launch of transition committees," though some speculated, "Those close to party leadership contender Jung Cheong-rae might have chosen not to go." <<> From the People Power Party, all four members—Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, Daegu Mayor-elect Choo Kyung-ho, North Gyeongsang Governor-elect Lee Cheol-woo, and South Gyeongsang Governor-elect Park Wan-soo—declined to attend. Some governors-elect reportedly considered attending but notified their absence at the last minute. A Prime Minister's Office official explained, "Since the meeting was hastily arranged after the local elections, some governors-elect informed us that it conflicted with their pre-scheduled plans." (김민석 국무총리가 15일 6·3 지방선거 시도지사 당선인들을 공관으로 불러 오찬 간담회를 했다. 당선인 16명을 다 불렀지만 오세훈 서울시장 등 국민의힘 소속은 4명 전원 불참했고 더불어민주당 소속도 12명 가운데 9명만 참석했다. 국민의힘에선 “총리가 취임도 안한 당선인들을 불러 모으는 건 이례적”이라며 “김 총리의 8월 당대표 선거 출마를 앞둔 정치 행사에 장단을 맞춰줄 필요가 있겠느냐”는 말이 나왔다. 김 총리는 한성숙 총리 후보자의 임명 절차가 끝나는 이달 말쯤 민주당 당 대표 출마 선언을 공식화할 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Democratic Party’s Local Election White Paper to Be Released Before Convention… Could Become Time Bomb Depending on Content (與 지방선거 백서, 전대 전에 내기로… 내용따라 시한폭탄 될 수도)
item.description:
Democratic Party’s Local Election White Paper to Be Released Before Convention… Could Become Time Bomb Depending on Content (與 지방선거 백서, 전대 전에 내기로… 내용따라 시한폭탄 될 수도)

The Democratic Party of Korea on the 15th established a committee to evaluate the June 3 local elections and parliamentary by-elections and began work on the white paper. The party leadership stated that the committee will analyze the impact of factors such as the push for a special counsel investigation into the fabricated indictment, the Starbucks boycott movement, and claims that Prime Minister Kim Min-seok is challenging for party leadership on the election results. In response, the pro-Moon faction is pushing back, saying, "The party bears the responsibility for the election, not the government, so who are they trying to shift the blame onto?" Within the ruling bloc, there is talk that the white paper, which will be published before the August party convention, could become another flashpoint in the leadership race. <<> The Democratic Party revealed the list of evaluation committee members on the same day. The co-chairpersons are Lee Jae-young, head of the Democratic Research Institute, and Hong Chang-min, former head of the Seoul City Party nomination management committee, while members include Lee Yeon-hee, head of the strategic planning committee. The evaluation committee will begin its work this week and operate for about eight weeks before publishing the white paper. This follows Representative Chung Cheong-rae’s statement on the 10th that, "We will publish a white paper to coldly diagnose the election’s successes and failures." <<> Secretary General Cho Seung-rae appeared on Kim Eo-jun’s YouTube channel on the same day and said of the evaluation committee’s work, "We need to conduct a trace investigation into how government and ruling party officials sent messages on issues that became flashpoints during the election, such as the fabricated indictment (special counsel) matter and the Starbucks issue, and how the public responded." The day before, Cho also brought up the claims of Prime Minister Kim Min-seok’s potential bid for party leadership, which surfaced just before the election. In relation to this, Senior Spokesperson Kang Joon-hyun told reporters, "We did not have any specific individual in mind," but added, "We should duly evaluate the impact of messages sent by government officials or politicians during the election process." <<> Among the pro-Moon faction, there have been reactions to Cho’s remarks, such as, "Isn’t this beating around the bush to say that the issues led by the pro-Moon faction, like the dismissal of the indictment case against the president, were major factors in the defeat in the Seoul, Daegu, and South Gyeongsang elections?" In particular, they said that mentioning Representative Kim, who is a rival in the party leadership race to Representative Chung, was highly inappropriate. A pro-Moon lawmaker commented, "It’s absurd for the Chung Cheong-rae leadership, which should step down and take responsibility for the election, to be the one evaluating the election," adding, "Isn’t this just out of ambition for the party leadership?" <<> A Democratic Party official said, "The evaluation committee will try to balance both sides’ positions as much as possible, but no matter how the white paper turns out, it will be impossible to avoid controversy." (더불어민주당은 15일 6·3 지방선거 및 국회의원 재·보궐선거 평가위원회를 설치하고 백서 작업에 착수했다. 민주당 지도부는 위원회에서 조작기소 특검법 추진, 스타벅스 불매 운동, 김민석 국무총리의 당권 도전설 등이 선거에 어떤 영향을 미쳤는지 등을 분석할 것이라고 했다. 이를 두고 친명계는 “선거 책임은 정부가 아닌 당이 지는 것인데 누구에게 책임을 떠넘기려는 것이냐”고 반발하고 있다. 여권에선 8월 전당대회 전에 발간될 백서가 당권 다툼의 또 다른 뇌관이 될 것이란 말이 나온다.)

item.title: 'New Lee Jae-myung' or Not... The Democratic Party National Convention is a Fight Beyond Party Leadership (‘뉴이재명’이냐 아니냐… 민주당 전대는 당권 그 이상의 싸움)
item.description:
'New Lee Jae-myung' or Not... The Democratic Party National Convention is a Fight Beyond Party Leadership (‘뉴이재명’이냐 아니냐… 민주당 전대는 당권 그 이상의 싸움)

Ahead of the Democratic Party of Korea's August leadership election, cracks within the ruling party are widening. On the surface, it appears to be a conflict between the pro-Myung (Lee Jae-myung) and pro-Chung (Chung Cheong-rae) factions over the next party leadership, but it is escalating into an all-out war between the so-called 'New Lee Jae-myung' faction—the party's new mainstream—and the traditional mainstream support base of the pro-Roh (Roh Moo-hyun) and pro-Moon (Moon Jae-in) forces. <<> President Lee Jae-myung has been making remarks targeting the leadership of Representative Chung Cheong-rae daily since the June 3 local elections. In a press conference on the 8th marking his first anniversary in office, he stated, "We lost where we needed to win," and followed up on social media platform X by saying, "The ruling party should focus more on the 'language of responsibility' than the 'language of conviction,'" taking aim at Chairman Chung. Particularly on the 9th, he reportedly instructed Chung not to attend his departure ceremony for a European tour. Ruling party insiders commented, "This could be seen as a message not to challenge for a second term as party leader." Subsequently, the pro-Myung faction has been openly demanding Chung's resignation as leader and that he not run in the upcoming party convention. <<> Chairman Chung initially described the election result as a "victory," but as criticism mounted over accountability, he stepped back, saying, "We will reflect on what needs to be reflected upon." However, he made a significant remark: "The government is short-lived, but the people are eternal." Pro-Chung insiders interpreted this as "strongly signaling his intention to run for a second term as party leader." Although Chung has not publicly addressed his future plans or whether he will run in the party convention, it is reported that he may reach a decision as early as this week. A close aide to Chung stated, "His bid for another term as party leader should be seen as a foregone conclusion." <<> The pro-Myung and pro-Chung conflict is spreading into a struggle among factions within the ruling party's support base, including the New Lee Jae-myung group and the pro-Roh/pro-Moon forces. The New Lee Jae-myung faction, which entered the Democratic Party after the last presidential election by advocating for "expanding the party's reach," is pushing for Prime Minister Kim Min-seok or lawmaker Song Young-gil—both close to the president—as the next party leader candidates. Meanwhile, the party's traditional support base is backing Chairman Chung Cheong-rae. <<> Prime Minister Kim Min-seok said on MBC Radio today that regarding the local elections, "It's a result that's hard to call a victory." Kim stated, "As we move into the mid-term, there will be various political difficulties, so it's better for the party to support the government and the president more stably. I believe it's time for me to go to the party and serve that role." <<> Pro-government online communities are splitting into two. On the 'Ddanji Ilbo' bulletin board, run by Kim Ou-joon, who is close to the pro-Roh and pro-Moon factions, critical posts targeting President Lee have been appearing one after another. Comments include, "The president should not interfere in party affairs," "Focus on people's livelihoods," "The New Lee Jae-myung, whose background is unknown, is muddying the waters of the Democratic Party," and "I will never support Kim Min-seok." Conversely, in President Lee's fan cafe, 'Jae-myung's Village,' a signature campaign is underway calling for Chairman Chung's resignation, with posts urging, "Don't seek division by riding on extremist forces." Supporters from both sides are flooding President Lee's X account and Chairman Chung's Facebook page with critical comments targeting each other. <<> Pro-government YouTubers are also raising their criticism levels against President Lee and Chairman Chung according to their own interests. Kim Ou-joon, known for backing Chairman Chung in last year's leadership election, brought up the failed merger issue between the Democratic Party and the Fatherland Innovation Party on YouTube on the 15th, a move opposed by the New Lee Jae-myung faction. On the 4th, the day after the elections, Kim had already blamed the New Lee Jae-myung faction for the defeat in the Seoul mayoral election, saying, "The failed merger was a foreseen outcome of the elections." A ruling party official noted, "In the recent June 3 re-election for Pyeongtaek-eul in Gyeonggi Province, the party split as the pro-Myung faction backed Kim Yong-nam, a 'New Lee Jae-myung' recruit by President Lee, while the pro-Moon/pro-Roh forces, including Yoo Si-min and Kim Ou-joon, supported candidate Jo Kuk. The Democratic Party is already fractured." <<> Amid the ruling party's division, a poll showing a reversal in party support rates has emerged. According to a survey released today by Realmeter, commissioned by the Energy Economy Newspaper, conducted on the 11th and 12th via wireless ARS automated response with 1,002 respondents, the Democratic Party garnered 38% support, while the People Power Party received 44.3%, a gap outside the margin of error (±3.1%p). President Lee's approval rating also fell by 3.7 percentage points from the previous week to 51.5%. <<> However, internal conflict within the Democratic Party continues. Supreme Council member Park Gyu-hwan, a pro-Chung figure, wrote on Facebook the previous day that "The people have shown a 'red card' to Lee Jae-myung's government over its first year." In response, pro-Myung Supreme Council members Hwang Myung-sun and Kang Deuk-gu reportedly strongly objected during a closed-door leadership meeting that day, questioning whether it was a remark targeting President Lee Jae-myung. <<> Some within the ruling party view the current situation as a power struggle between new and old forces over the future leadership of the party. A key ruling party official said, "From President Lee's perspective, who desperately needs to recreate the government for re-election, this convention is a must-win situation to seize control of the ruling party. However, since the pro-Chung faction is aligning with the pro-Moon and pro-Roh forces, both intent on holding onto the party leadership, there is potential for this to escalate into an all-out internal war." (더불어민주당의 8월 당대표 선거를 앞두고 여권 내 균열이 커지고 있다. 표면적으론 차기 당권을 둘러싼 명청 갈등처럼 보이지만, 이른바 ‘뉴이재명’으로 불리는 민주당 신주류와 전통적 주류 지지층인 친노·친문의 세력 간 전면전 대결로 번지고 있다.)

item.title: President Lee Meets Pope, Requests Visit to North Korea Next Year (李 대통령, 교황 만나 내년 남북 방문 요청)
item.description:
President Lee Meets Pope, Requests Visit to North Korea Next Year (李 대통령, 교황 만나 내년 남북 방문 요청)

President Lee Jae-myung, on an official visit to the Vatican, reportedly met with Pope Leo XIV at the Vatican on the 15th (local time) and formally requested that the Pope visit North Korea to help resolve issues between the two Koreas. While officially inviting the Pope for the World Youth Day event to be held in Seoul in August next year, he asked the Pope to play a role in peace on the Korean Peninsula by also visiting North Korea during his trip to South Korea. (바티칸을 공식 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 15일(현지 시각) 교황청에서 레오 14세 교황을 만나 남북 문제 해결을 위해 북한을 방문해 달라고 공식 요청한 것으로 알려졌다. 내년 8월 서울에서 개최되는 세계청년대회 계기에 교황을 공식 초청하면서, 교황의 방한 때 한반도 평화를 위해 방북해 역할을 해달라고 요청한 것이다.)

South Korea's National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac said in a briefing following the meeting between the President and the Pope that day, "The President conveyed to the Pope the aspirations of our people for peace on the Korean Peninsula and our government's vision, reaffirming the Vatican's unwavering support and interest in peace and reconciliation on the Korean Peninsula." A senior official at the presidential office added, "The meeting comprehensively discussed inter-Korean issues and matters of peace and security on the Korean Peninsula. The President expressed expectations for the Catholic Church's contribution and role in peace and stability on the peninsula, and I heard that the Pope responded positively." (위성락 청와대 국가안보실장은 이날 이 대통령과 교황의 면담 뒤 브리핑에서 “대통령은 교황에게 한반도 평화 정착에 대한 우리 국민의 염원과 우리 정부의 구상에 대해 말하고 교황청의 한반도 평화·화해를 위한 변함없는 지지와 관심을 재확인했다”고 말했다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 “면담에서 남북한 문제와 한반도 평화·안전 문제를 포괄적으로 논의했다”며 “대통령이 한반도의 평화와 안정에 대한 천주교의 기여와 역할에 대해 기대를 표했고, 이에 대해서 교황의 호응하는 말이 있었다고 들었다”고 했다.)

The meeting between President Lee and the Pope lasted nearly 30 minutes and was held without any aides present. President Lee expressed gratitude for the Catholic Church's significant contributions to Korea's modernization and democratization, requesting its role in peace on the Korean Peninsula. A senior presidential official stated, "Messages from the Pope or the Vatican regarding reconciliation and peace on the Korean Peninsula are important. If the Pope sends such a message during his visit to South Korea at the World Youth Day event, it would be helpful." (이 대통령과 교황의 면담은 이날 배석자 없이 단독으로 30분 가까이 이뤄졌다. 이 대통령은 한국의 근대화, 민주화 과정에서 천주교의 기여가 컸다고 감사를 표하며, 한반도 평화에서의 역할을 요청했다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 “교황이나 교황청이 발신하는 한반도 화해·평화에 대한 메시지가 중요하다”며 “교황의 방한 때 세계청년대회에서 그런 메시지를 발신한다면 도움이 될 것”이라고 했다.)

◇Will the Pope's Visit to North Korea Happen? Cardinal You Heung-sik Says "It's Up to North Korea" (◇교황 방북 이뤄질까… 유흥식 추기경 “북한에 달렸다”)

President Lee also met with Cardinal Pietro Parolin, the Vatican's Secretary of State, following his meeting with the Pope, discussing inter-Korean issues. A senior official said that President Lee quoted a phrase from the Bible, "Knock and the door will be opened," indicating that while the two Koreas are currently cut off, they will persevere and work hard. The Vatican side reportedly agreed that patience is needed and responded that "not just patience, but hope is needed." (이 대통령은 교황에 이어 피에트로 파롤린 교황청 국무원장과도 만나 남북 문제 등을 논의했다. 이 대통령은 남북이 지금은 단절되어 어렵지만 인내하고 노력하겠다면서 성경에 나오는 ‘두드려라, 그러면 열릴 것이다’라는 문구를 인용했다고 고위 관계자는 전했다. 이에 교황청 측에서도 인내가 필요할 것이라는 데 공감했고 ‘인내뿐만 아니라 희망이 필요하다’고 답했다고 한다.)

However, regarding the possibility of the Pope actually visiting North Korea, a senior presidential official said, "There was talk of the possibility, but it's a complex issue." The official added, "It can only happen if North Korea agrees or invites him. Given North Korea's current strong stance of rejection externally, there are some constraints in discussions." (다만 청와대 고위 관계자는 교황의 실제 방북 가능성에 대해선 “가능성에 대한 거론이 있었지만, 복잡한 문제”라고 했다. 이 관계자는 “북한이 응하든 초청하든 해야 성사되는 문제”라며 “북한이 지금 대외적으로 보이는 거부적 입장이 강력히 있는 상황이어서 논의에 약간 제약이 있다”고 했다.)

In this regard, Cardinal Lazarus You Heung-sik, a Vatican minister, also told reporters the previous day, "North Korea needs to invite him and create the conditions. It's up to North Korea." Cardinal You mentioned that the Pope is American, saying, "I think he could play a role in opening up North Korea-U.S. relations (compared to popes from other countries)." He also said he has spoken with the Pope about his role on the Korean Peninsula, recounting, "The Pope smiled and said, 'How nice would it be if I could play a role?'" (이와 관련, 교황청 장관인 유흥식 추기경도 전날 취재진과 만나 “북한이 초청하고 여건을 만들어야 된다”며 “북한에 달려 있는 것”이라고 말했다. 유 추기경은 교황이 미국인이라는 점을 언급하며 “(다른 국가 출신 교황에 비해) 북미 관계를 트는 데 역할을 할 수 있지 않을까 생각이 든다”고도 했다. 유 추기경은 교황과 한반도에서의 역할에 대해 대화한 적이 있다며 “교황님도 웃으며 ‘나도 역할을 할 수 있으면 얼마나 좋겠느냐’고 말했다”고 했다.)

Cardinal You stated, "All the political and economic situations (in South Korea) have changed, and because I've kept informing him of the situation, the Pope is well aware of it." Regarding the meeting between President Lee and the Pope, Cardinal You said, "I’m not sure if this is the right expression, but I think the two of them will hit it off well. I hope President Lee draws strength from the Pope. Receiving support from the Pope could also elevate South Korea's international standing." (유 추기경은 “(한국의) 정치·경제 등 모든 상황이 바뀌었고 그런 상황을 계속 말씀드렸기 때문에, 교황님도 상황을 잘 알고 계시다”고 했다. 유 추기경은 이 대통령과 교황의 만남에 대해 “표현이 맞는지 모르겠지만, 두 분이 죽이 잘 맞으실 것 같다”면서 “대통령님이 교황님한테 힘을 받았으면 좋겠다. 교황님한테 힘을 받으면 실제로 국제적인 위상도 좀 높아진다”고 했다.)

President Lee presented the Pope with a sculpture depicting the biblical story of the "Prodigal Son" titled "God's Embrace" and a white porcelain multi-purpose box as gifts. He gave Cardinal Parolin premium red ginseng extract and other items. (이 대통령은 이날 교황에게 성경 속 ‘돌아온 탕아’ 이야기를 형상화해 ‘하느님의 품’이라는 이름을 붙인 조각상, 백자 다용도 합을 선물했다. 파롤린 국무원장에게는 프리미엄 홍삼 달임액 등을 선물했다.)

President Lee will depart on the 16th for Évian, France, where the G7 Summit is being held. Regarding the possibility of a meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump, who is attending the G7 Summit, a senior presidential official said, "We're keeping the possibility open, but it's hard to say there's concrete progress (in discussions with the U.S.). It's not a topic we're focusing on." This suggests that the primary goal of attending the G7 Summit is to strengthen relations with key European Union (EU) countries. (이 대통령은 16일 G7 정상회의가 열리는 프랑스 에비앙으로 이동한다. G7 정상회의에 참석하는 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 회담 가능성에 대해, 청와대 고위 관계자는 “가능성을 열어두고 있지만 (미국과 협의에) 구체적인 진전이 있다고 보기는 어렵다”며 “우리가 주안점을 두고 추진하는 주제는 아니다”라고 했다. G7 정상회의 참석의 주요한 목적은 유럽연합(EU) 주요국과의 관계 강화에 있다는 의미다.)

item.title: $14.3 Billion Spent, Overseas Voting Turnout at 4.7% (143억 쓰고 재외선거 투표율 4.7%)
item.description:
$14.3 Billion Spent, Overseas Voting Turnout at 4.7% (143억 쓰고 재외선거 투표율 4.7%)

The National Election Commission (NEC) maintains 22 overseas election officers in nine countries even in non-election years to prepare for overseas voting. Based on a two-year dispatch period, the budget per person amounts to approximately 150 million won. Overseas elections are held during presidential and general elections, with 14.3 billion won spent for the 2024 National Assembly election and 11.6 billion won for the 2022 presidential election. These costs include operating expenses for polling stations set up at overseas diplomatic missions, aviation and logistics costs for sending and returning ballots, promotional expenses, equipment rental, and computer network setup. Based on the total overseas Korean population of about 1.97 million, the overseas voter turnout was 4.7% in the 2024 general election and 10.4% in the 2025 presidential election. (중앙선관위는 재외 선거를 준비하기 위해 선거가 없는 해에도 통상 9국에 재외선거관 22명을 두고 있다. 파견 2년 기준 1인당 1억5000만원 정도의 예산을 쓰고 있다. 재외선거는 대선과 총선 때 이뤄지는데 2024년 국회의원 선거에는 143억원, 작년 대통령 선거에는 116억원이 들어갔다. 재외공관에 설치되는 투표소 운영비, 투표 용지 발송·회송에 들어가는 항공·물류비, 홍보비, 장비 대여 및 전산망 구축 비용 등이다. 전체 재외 국민 약 197만명 기준으로 재외 투표율은 2024년 총선 4.7%, 2025년 대선 10.4%였다.)

Overseas voter turnout was higher in countries where election officers were not dispatched. Over the past 15 years, the average turnout in countries without dispatched election officers—such as India, Ethiopia, and Thailand—was 6.8%, which is 3.1 percentage points higher than the 3.7% in dispatched countries. The NEC, which established overseas election commissions in 2011, dispatches a maximum of 22 election officers to 22 diplomatic missions in nine countries—including the United States, Canada, Japan, Germany, France, Australia, Vietnam, the Philippines, and China—depending on election schedules. The United States receives the most election officers at eight, yet the average voter turnout hovers around 5%. The dispatch period ranges from a few months to two to three years. (재외 투표율은 선거관이 파견되지 않은 국가가 더 높았다. 지난 15년간 평균 투표율을 보면, 선거관 미파견국인 인도·에티오피아·태국 등의 투표율은 평균 6.8%로, 파견국의 3.7%보다 3.1%포인트 높았다. 2011년 재외 선관위를 신설한 선관위는 선거 일정 등에 따라 미국·캐나다·일본·독일·프랑스·호주·베트남·필리핀·중국 등 9국 22개 공관에 최대 선거관 22명을 파견하고 있다. 미국에 가장 많은 8명의 선거관이 파견되지만, 평균 투표율은 5% 안팎이다. 파견 기간은 짧게는 수개월, 길게는 2~3년에 이른다.)

There has been no external audit of the budget for operating overseas election commissions and conducting overseas elections. Yoo Hee-sang, a former commissioner of the Board of Audit and Inspection, stated, "Activities to encourage and support overseas Koreans' voting are necessary," but added, "Whether the massive election budget is being used properly should be verified." (재외 선관위 운영과 재외 선거에 들어가는 예산에 대한 외부 감사는 이뤄진 적이 없었다. 유희상 전 감사원 감사위원은 “재외 국민의 투표를 장려·지원하는 활동은 필요하다”면서도 “막대한 선거 관련 예산을 제대로 쓰고 있는지는 검증받아야 한다”고 했다.)
